sections.title: Listening: People & Appearance
sections.description: Listen once for gist and again for detail.

audio.transcript: This is my friend Nina. She is twenty years old and she is quite tall. She has long curly hair and wears glasses. Nina is friendly, but she is quiet when she meets new people. She loves drawing portraits. Her younger brother, Leo, looks like her, but he has short straight hair. He is very talkative and often makes everyone laugh.

gistQuestions.prompt: What is the speaker mainly doing?
gistQuestions.explanation: The complete recording supports this main idea.

detailQuestions.prompt: How is Nina different when meeting new people?
detailQuestions.explanation: This detail is stated in the recording. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

tip.title: Listening Strategy
tip.text: Use the first listen for context and the second listen to confirm exact details.

sections.title: Speaking: People & Appearance
sections.description: Prepare briefly, record your response and review it.
questions: Describe a friend or family member.
What does this person look like?
sections.sampleAnswer: My cousin Minh is twenty-two years old. He is tall and has short black hair. He wears glasses. He is friendly and very funny, but he is sometimes quiet with new people.
prompts: Answer every part of the prompt.

tip.title: Speaking Tip
tip.text: Organise your answer into a clear beginning, two details and a short ending.
